text:
zara (Finance): Skyline Resellers submitted a ticket — they say AWS Marketplace invoices for Mar show a 7% "platform" surcharge twice (line item + marketplace fee). Total disputed: $26,743. Can Marketplaces team confirm?

billing-bot: New dispute: DSP-2026-03-411 | partner: Skyline Resellers (SKY-501) | amount: 26743.00 | invoices: [INV-AWS-2026-03-778, INV-AWS-2026-03-779]

ty (Marketplaces): looking. pulling marketplace reporting now. quick check — did they migrate to consolidated pricing last month? that can change how fees are applied.

zara (Finance): They did a listing update on 2026-02-26 per Sales Ops note. Jules?

jules (Sales Ops): confirmed — we switched Skyline to "consolidated_listing_v2" 02/26 to enable bundle pricing. I told partner it'd be revenue-neutral, didn't realize fee calc changed.

ty (Marketplaces): grabbed the listing config and invoice breakdown. snippet from marketplace-usage-export.csv:
```
invoice_id,partner_id,sku,list_price_usd,marketplace_fee_pct,marketplace_fee_usd,platform_surcharge_usd,total_usd
INV-AWS-2026-03-778,SKY-501,redwood:hosted,15000.00,0.07,1050.00,1050.00,170100.00
INV-AWS-2026-03-779,SKY-501,redwood:hosted,12000.00,0.07,840.00,840.00,136260.00
```
looks like marketplace_fee_usd and platform_surcharge_usd are both present and equal. config shows price_formula: "list_price + marketplace_fee + platform_surcharge" while marketplace engine already embeds marketplace_fee into list_price for consolidated listings. so double-count.

alex (Tax): Does double-counting affect tax calculation? need to check nexus. If the fee was included in taxable base then credit may change tax amounts.

zara (Finance): Ok — what are proposed remediations and impact to revenue?

ty (Marketplaces): Proposed steps:
1) Issue partner-level adjustment to remove duplicated platform_surcharge lines for the two invoices (total credit $26,743.00).
2) Emit Credit Note CN-2026-03-1011 to Skyline for $26,743.00 (reason: duplicate platform surcharge due to listing formula migration).
3) Patch listing migration script to set price_formula correctly for consolidated_listing_v2 (remove explicit marketplace_fee add). Add unit test covering this case.
4) Run a backfill to detect any other partners migrated between 2026-02-24 and 2026-03-02 and produce audit list.

jules (Sales Ops): I'll notify Skyline and offer payment hold or apply credit to next invoice. they prefer credit applied.

zara (Finance): Alex — need GL codes for JE and confirm tax fix process.

alex (Tax): GLs: 4001 (Revenue), 1200 (AR), tax rounding variance to 5305. Also: we need to adjust tax lines per jurisdiction; I'll request a TaxCalc re-run for the two invoices.

billing-bot: Action requested: create_credit_note (invoice_ids: [INV-AWS-2026-03-778, INV-AWS-2026-03-779], amount: 26743.00, reason: "Duplicate platform surcharge after listing migration" ) -> Ticket BILL-4810 created.

ty (Marketplaces): running backfill scan now. will attach results. expected fix deployed in 2 hours after tests.

azara (Finance): small typo — that's me :) Please attach updated PDFs and CN when done.

jules (Sales Ops): Skyline replied : they appreciate the quick response and asked for confirmation that future listing migrations will be validated. I'll add that to rollout checklist.

ty (Marketplaces): Patch deployed to prod (release 2026.3.11). Backfill found 3 other partners with same dup-charge; creating credits for all. Logged BILL-4810.

zara (Finance): Approved. CN text below is fine for issuance.
```
Credit Note CN-2026-03-1011
Partner: Skyline Resellers (SKY-501)
Amount: $26,743.00
Reason: Duplicate platform surcharge resulting from listing migration to consolidated pricing.
Action: Credit to be applied to next invoice per partner preference.
```

billing-bot: Credit note issued CN-2026-03-1011. AP hold applied to INV-AWS-2026-03-778 and INV-AWS-2026-03-779 until reconciliation.

amber (Customer Success): Noted. I'll follow up with Skyline to confirm credit applied. Thanks team :raised_hands:
